We need to get precursors for applying the template that was result of make_6_lvl2-template_search-2. That task failed. We need to find appropriate template for Friedel-Crafts acylation retrosynthesis of the given molecule: COc1ccc(CNc2c(C(=O)Nc3cccc(OC)c3)nnn2Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)cc1

We need to apply a template that breaks a halide (C-Cl) and forms C-C and C=O (acylation). So we need a template ID for Friedel-Crafts acylation. We can search template catalog by criteria but need correct bond format: bonds are specified as atomic numbers? Eg "6-6" for C-C bond, "6-8" for C-O? For C=O maybe "6-8". For C-Cl "6-17". So we can search with bonds_broken ["6-17"], bonds_formed ["6-6","6-8"]. Let's try.
